svg.text: TENGU GLADE - PAINTED TERRAIN CONTEXT R100
Exact native meadow shape; no new terrain height, village buildings, tunnel or active footpath.
Enlarged original painting pixels: tiny biome patch only, not a completed village or a flattened court.
58 site registrations retained;20 context names; inventory138 with42 physical follow-ups unchanged.
The C15 surface-path proposal remains inactive. Exact parcel and meadow choice are our interpretation.
